title: Absolute q-power Frobenius of a scheme in characteristic p
statement:
Let $p$ be a prime number and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-scheme-characteristic-p], i.e. $p=0$ in $\mathcal O_X$. The *absolute Frobenius* of $X$ is the morphism of schemes $F_X:X\to X$ that is the identity on the underlying topological space and whose map of structure sheaves [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] $F_X^\sharp:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_X$ is $g\mapsto g^p$ on sections over every open set, i.e. the Frobenius endomorphism [def-weil-ring-frobenius] of each ring $\mathcal O_X(U)$. (This is a morphism of locally ringed spaces because, for every ring $A$ of characteristic $p$, $a\mapsto a^p$ is a ring endomorphism of $A$ inducing the identity on $\operatorname{Spec}A$, and is a local homomorphism when $A$ is local [lem-weil-absolute-frobenius-well-defined].) For $q=p^a$ with $a\geq1$, the *absolute $q$-power Frobenius* of $X$ is the $a$-fold iterate (composite in the category of schemes)

$$
 \operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_X=F_X^a:X\longrightarrow X,
$$

the identity on the underlying space with $g\mapsto g^q$ on $\mathcal O_X$; on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X$ it is $\operatorname{Spec}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] of the ring endomorphism $a\mapsto a^q$ of $A$ [lem-weil-absolute-frobenius-well-defined].

source.place: Varieties, Section 33.36 'Frobenii' (tag 0CC6), Definition 33.36.1 (tag 03SM, label definition-absolute-frobenius) for $F_X$; the $q$-power iterate is the 'endomorphisme de Frobenius x ↦ x^q de X_0' of Deligne, Weil II (1.1.14), p. 153 (pdf p. 18)

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks varieties.tex Section 33.36 (tag 0CC6), Definition 33.36.1 (tag 03SM) and the paragraph after it; the statement is faithful (the q-power iterate and the affine description are additions consistent with Deligne Weil II (1.1.14)). Named the notions it is built from: schemes and their composition (def-pc-scheme, Mathlib), schemes of characteristic p (new def-weil-scheme-characteristic-p, unsplit: Mathlib has no characteristic of a scheme), the Frobenius endomorphism of a ring of characteristic p and its iterates (new def-weil-ring-frobenius, Mathlib leaf `frobenius`/`iterateFrobenius`, caveat: Mathlib needs ExpChar, which the zero ring lacks), morphisms of ringed/locally ringed spaces given by a continuous map and a map of structure sheaves (new def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism, Mathlib leaf `LocallyRingedSpace.Hom`/`Scheme.Hom`), Spec of a ring map (def-weil-affine-spectrum). The definition needs a proof that (id, g ↦ g^p) is a morphism of locally ringed spaces and that it is Spec(F_A) on affines: that is the new statement node lem-weil-absolute-frobenius-well-defined (unsplit; Stacks states (i)-(ii) only in passing). Mathlib has no absolute Frobenius of a scheme, not even the affine case Spec.map (frobenius): recorded.
